section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that when a desire stems from essential pleasure beyond intellect, the flow from will to action occurs swiftly without delay, as the will immediately activates the intellect and subsequent stages automatically.
section.t: Now, the delay that can occur in the flow from one level to another is when one's desire for the matter is based on intellect.
However, when the desire is because one has pleasure in it,
and especially when there is an essential pleasure that is above intellect,
then,
the flow from the will to the action is swift,
without delay.
For when it arises in His will to desire the matter,
the will immediately acts upon the intellect,
so that it understands intellectually that it is fitting to desire the matter,
and from the intellect it is immediately drawn to thought, and from thought to speech, and from speech to action.
And all these flows are swift, without delay.
And there are two aspects to this.
First, after he has decided in his intellect the general matter, he does not need to consult and deliberate whether it is fitting to think, speak, and do.
And moreover,
all these flows
[from intellect to thought,
from thought to speech, and from speech to action]
are in a manner of automatically,
for due to the greatness of the desire and pleasure in the matter, he will not rest nor be still until the matter is actualized in deed.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section applies the analogy to the supernal realm, explaining that when the source of the flow is from the aspect of "Rav Chesed" above the chain of descent, the influence descends through all levels swiftly without delay, as in the Priestly Blessing.
section.t: And similarly in the analogue above,
for when the root of the flow is from the aspect of Rav Chesed that is above the chain of descent,
then,
the influence is drawn downward,
through the stages of the entire order of the chain of descent,
with great swiftness, without delays.
For in addition to the fact that in this flow there are no judgments that would delay the flows from level to level,
also the flows themselves are in a manner of automatically.
And this is that the flow of the Priestly Blessing is swift,
for the flow of the Priestly Blessing is from above the chain of descent
[as explained elsewhere
that in the Priestly Blessing there is also the advantage of prayer,
for through prayer a new will is drawn that is above the chain of descent],
and therefore the flow is swift.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section adds that the flow of the Priestly Blessing is from the very highest level to the very lowest, and because it is swift and uninterrupted, the influence descends in great abundance, explaining the connection between speed and the blessing's comprehensive nature.
section.t: And there is further to add an aspect regarding the advantage of the Priestly Blessing,
that the flow of the Priestly Blessing is from the very highest level
[and as above, the root of the flow is above the chain of descent]
down to the very lowest level
[and as above, the flow of the Priestly Blessing is also for those who, from the aspect of the attribute of judgment, are not worthy].
And since the flow of the Priestly Blessing is swift and is not delayed,
therefore,
when the influence is drawn downward, it is in great abundance.
And based on this, we can explain the continuation of the topics in the discourse in Likkutei Torah,
that after he explains that the flow of the Priestly Blessing is swift,
he brings the exposition of our sages, of blessed memory,
on the verse,
"May Hashem bless you and guard you,"
"May He bless you with wealth... may He bless you with children... and guard you from harmful forces,"
for at first glance it is not understood,
for in the aforementioned exposition of our sages, only what the flow is is explained
(blessing with wealth and children and protection from harmful forces),
and in Likkutei Torah he brings this exposition regarding the matter that the flow is swift,
and one must say the explanation of this,
that "May He bless you with wealth and children" indicates the abundance of influence, that the influence is in all matters of children, life, and sustenance
[for in "May He bless you with wealth" is also included the blessing for life,
for when the Merciful One gives abundance, it is for life that He gives],
and the matter of "and guard you from harmful forces" indicates that the drawing of the influence is to the very lowest level,
even to a place that requires protection from harmful forces,
and the connection of these two matters,
that even when the influence is drawn to the very lowest level
("and guard you from harmful forces")
it is in great abundance
("May He bless you with wealth and children"),
is because the flow is swift and is not delayed.
